gen-gf-cause-gf-syncopate: Loose, friendly handwriting up top. Cause leans on that wide-open e and diagonals that echo its stems, while Syncopate follows in sans-serif with a technical-pen steadiness.
gen-gf-cause-manrope: Approachable through and through, with Manrope as the quiet partner. Cause brings a hand-drawn warmth, and below it the plain sans keeps a bright gap at every curve, so pages of it stay inviting and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-cause-switzer: Hand-drawn warmth meets wiry precision here, with Cause leaning friendly and Switzer drawing tubular, tall-waisted letters. The mix of casual and Swiss is what sticks.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-epunda-slab: Chelsea Market's open-bellied g and skyward x-height shout first. Epunda Slab, a text serif with tall rounded lowercase and a gaping c, settles into paragraphs with dignity and stays readable line after line.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One has a literary, dignified feel, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. Chelsea Market is loud beside it; give that heading plenty of size.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, its big counters and wide-mouthed curves giving every line room to breathe. And Chelsea Market, bold and expressive, gives that quiet text a loud, open-g headline to stand against.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-graduate: Graduate spaces its letters generously and draws each one with a single constant line, so it feels bookish and dignified. Against Chelsea Market, the difference is the point.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditional and refined, its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals giving text a measured stride. But Chelsea Market, expressive and bold with its open-curved g, keeps the top of the page loud and lively.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-kadwa: Chelsea Market is bold and expressive. Kadwa, a classic serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, takes over below, while the heading earns its keep when big and short.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-gf-noticia-text: Literary and dignified, Noticia Text lets big entrances into each curve and lowercase bodies filling most of the height carry the reading. And Chelsea Market, with its open-tailed g, works best at a generous size up top.
